activationPolicy.semantics: The migration importer supports include/alias and set/map declarations, but staging a tenant-supplied nginx fragment on a shared edge (the same scanner is called by sdkwork-webserver-edge-runtime before activation) rejects file inclusion, path-escape aliases, variable-assigned URL literals, and proxy targets that resolve to loopback, private, metadata, or unix-socket destinations.
